Messages.Author: Mael
Messages.Body:
I also get this problem whenever I try to read threads with new posts, when I'm logged in.

The error I get is
>
> The www.vekn.net page isn’t working
>
> www.vekn.net redirected you too many times.
> ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS
>
It doesn't seem to happen when browsing old topics, and only happens when I'm logged in.
It also prevents me from seeing any reply I make without first logging out.
The only way I've found that I can post and reply to topics is by logging out, reading the threads, and logging in when I've got the comment open I want to reply to.

Using chrome. Haven't tested it on other browsers.
